'''Sarnova''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], nicknamed '''Duchess''' by her troops, who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Stationed outside the rogue [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Grathan]]'s [[Lord Grathan's estate|estate]], she commanded nearly a hundred [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] assigned to the sector surrounding [[the Wall]], some posted on the wall itself, others watching Grathan. Twenty of her men were abducted by [[Lord Grathan's forces|Grathan's forces]], and she enlisted the aid of a passing Imperial spacer to find out what had become of them.<ref name="TWM" />
